title: Database Schema: Task Submissions
description: Create SQL script to create `task_submissions` table with fields: id, task_id, user_id, type (enum), content, cloudinary_public_id, is_public.

title: Cloudinary Setup & Server Actions
description: Add CLOUDINARY_URL to .env.local. Implement Next.js Server Actions for secure file upload (`uploadSubmissionMedia`) and synchronized deletion (`deleteSubmissionMedia`) using Cloudinary Node.js SDK.

title: Submissions UI & Form Handling
description: Update `TaskDetailModal` to include a 'Bài nộp' (Submissions) tab. Build components to handle Text, Link, and File uploads with progress indicators and optimistic UI.

title: Privacy RBAC & Leader Toggle
description: Implement `isFileVisible` logic (owner, leader, public). Add a toggle switch for Leaders to mark submissions as public, updating the `is_public` field in DB.
